description.zh: 查询的结束时间，单位：秒。如果不设置该参数，结束时间为当前的查询时间。
description.en: The end of the time range to query. Unit: seconds. If you do not specify this parameter, the current time is used.

description.zh:
WAF实例的ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeInstance](~~433756~~)查询当前WAF实例的ID。
description.en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) to query the ID of the current WAF instance.

description.zh:
规则命中次数是否聚合防护对象。

- **true（默认）**：表示聚合防护对象的规则命中次数，即只按照单个防护规则命中情况统计次数，当前情况下发返回参数中Resource值为空。
- **false**：表示不聚合防护对象的规则命中次数，即按照防护对象和防护规则命中情况统计次数。
description.en:
Specifies whether to aggregate rule hits by protected object.

- **true (default)**: Aggregates rule hits by protected object. In this case, rule hits are counted based on individual rules only, and the Resource value in the response is empty.
- **false**: Does not aggregate rule hits by protected object. In this case, rule hits are counted based on both protected objects and rules.

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.
The Alibaba Cloud resource group ID.

description.zh:
防护对象命中的规则类型。默认不设置该参数，表示显示全部规则。

- **blacklist**: 表示命中IP黑名单。

- **custom**：表示命中自定义规则。

- **antiscan**: 表示命中扫描防护规则。

- **cc_system**:  表示命中CC防护规则。

- **region_block**: 表示区域封禁。
description.en:
The type of rule hit by the protected object. By default, this parameter is not specified, which indicates that all rules are displayed.

- **blacklist**: IP blacklist.

- **custom**: Custom rule.

- **antiscan**: Scan protection rule.

- **cc_system**: HTTP flood mitigation rule.

- **region_block**: Location blacklist.

description.zh: 查询的开始时间，单位：秒。
description.en: The beginning of the time range to query. Unit: seconds.

title.zh: 查看命中防护规则的Top 10规则ID
title.en: Query top 10 rule iDs by rule hits
